premises.text: Idle cash balances in P2P apps earn returns for the apps while users lose to inflation and lack an easy way to start investing
premises.evidence_span: it's those same peer-to-peer apps that are benefiting from cash balances and earning a return, leaving nothing behind for their users

premises.text: Peer-to-peer pay/request settles in the recipient's chosen stock via a fast simple secure flow (cash on backend until accept; accept as stock, switch stock, or cash)
premises.evidence_span: the first peer-to-peer payment designed to generate wealth with every single transaction

premises.text: Social layer makes portfolios, trades, and transactions public for likes/comments to make investing less lonely and more transparent
premises.evidence_span: Stacks is also social, and we make all portfolios and trades and transactions public, so you can like and comment on various transactions

premises.text: Brokerage partner coverage protects user cash balances and portfolio investments (stated up to 250K / 500K)
premises.evidence_span: We cover up to 250K of user cash balances and 500K of portfolio investments using our brokerage partner, Alpaca

domains.name: Idle P2P cash vs wealth building

value.text: Turn every peer-to-peer payment into an investment that builds generational wealth
value.evidence_span: allowing anyone to turn every payment into an investment

causal_links.evidence_span: Millennials, Gen Z, all of us want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time, or energy or resources to invest
I just contributed to her long-term wealth goals just by going out to dinner with her
The ultimate goal here is to make investing less lonely
make sure that our users feel 100% safe and confident when investing with us long-term

notes: Accept/switch/cash options and tax/paperwork friction contrast folded into pay-in-stock mechanism. Rideshare/registry/business plug-ins treated as vision/roadmap (rule 4), not premises. D3/D4 singletons retained as independently revisable social and safety modules.
